text_normalization: NFKC, lowercase/casefold, light punctuation cleanup, whitespace normalization
score_formula: 100 * weighted available mean of: 0.50 text cosine + 0.15 location + 0.15 amount + 0.10 date proximity + 0.05 sector match + 0.03 sub-sector match + 0.02 implementing-agency match
threshold_interpretation: The historical score>=75 field is retained for compatibility; review_candidate is the conservative operational review queue. Neither field is an MPLADS rule, legal conclusion, identity determination, or finding of wrongdoing.

review_policy.interpretation: Conservative evidence-based review selection; it does not establish work identity or wrongdoing.
